payload.claim: Change the view if (a) Michael Kors posts two consecutive quarters of positive constant-currency revenue growth with flat-to-lower markdown intensity, (b) TTM EBIT margin from continuing operations sustains above roughly 6% rather than the current 2.35%, or (c) free cash flow conversion recovers above ~60% of net income for a full year, confirming the adjusted EPS is real cash. Conversely, escalate to a harder negative if FY2027 revenue guidance is cut below ~$3.3bn, if gross margin gains reverse under tariff pass-through, or if the integrity gate escalates from Flag toward Disqualifying on any matter touching the company's own reported numbers.

prediction.reasoning: Q1 FY2027 revenue fell 3.5% and management's own ~$3.40bn FY2027 guide implies roughly a 3% decline against a ~$3.5bn continuing-operations base, with traffic still negative at Michael Kors; the market's reverse DCF is paying for only -0.7% a year, so I am explicitly betting that near-term contraction runs steeper than the price assumes even as gross margin improves.
